caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick that appears to be made of blue glass, rendered in shades of blue, purple, and white to indicate highlights and reflections on the faceted surface. The candlestick has a hexagonal base, a gradually tapering body with ribbed and smooth sections, and a flared candle holder at the top. Adjacent to the base of the candlestick, on the lower right side of the composition, there is a simple line drawing of a hexagonal geometric shape with concentric circles at its center, matching the base of the candlestick. The background is plain and light-colored, with some small brownish stains or marks scattered around the surface.
title: Glass Candlestick
